851902.name: PMT7
851902.summary: Predicted to enable dolichyl-phosphate-mannose-protein mannosyltransferase activity. Predicted to be involved in protein O-linked glycosylation via mannose. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851908.name: PIB1
851908.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of gluconeogenesis; protein ubiquitination; and regulation of protein stability. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane and late endosome. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851909.name: RAD34
851909.summary: Predicted to enable DNA damage sensor activity. Involved in nucleotide-excision repair. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851910.name: IPK1
851910.summary: Enables inositol-1,3,4,5,6-pentakisphosphate 2-kinase activity. Involved in inositol phosphate biosynthetic process and nuclear-transcribed mRNA catabolic process, non-stop decay. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851948.name: MRP1
851948.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of mitochondrial small ribosomal subunit. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851965.name: ESC2
851965.summary: Enables DNA binding activity and SUMO ligase regulator activity. Involved in several processes, including mitotic intra-S DNA damage checkpoint signaling; positive regulation of protein sumoylation; and silent mating-type cassette heterochromatin formation. Acts upstream of or within positive regulation of endodeoxyribonuclease activity. Located in nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

851981.name: BCS1
851981.description: bifunctional AAA family ATPase chaperone/translocase BCS1
851981.otherdesignations: bifunctional AAA family ATPase chaperone/translocase BCS1
851981.nomenclaturename: bifunctional AAA family ATPase chaperone/translocase BCS1
851981.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity; ATPase-coupled transmembrane transporter activity; and transmembrane protein transporter activity. Involved in chaperone-mediated protein complex assembly; mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III assembly; and protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study Bjornstad syndrome; GRACILE syndrome; and mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 1. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Bjornstad syndrome; GRACILE syndrome; and mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 1. Orthologous to human BCS1L (BCS1 ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase complex chaperone). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851984.name: LSM6
851984.summary: Contributes to RNA binding activity. Involved in RNA metabolic process. Located in P-body and nucleolus. Part of Lsm1-7-Pat1 complex; sno(s)RNA-containing ribonucleoprotein complex; and spliceosomal snRNP complex. Orthologous to human LSM6 (LSM6 homolog, U6 small nuclear RNA and mRNA degradation associated). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851990.name: RPP2B
851990.summary: Enables molecular function inhibitor activity and protein kinase activator activity. A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cytoplasmic translation. Located in fungal-type vacuole. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPLP2 (ribosomal protein lateral stalk subunit P2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

851993.name: EFT2
851993.summary: Enables several functions, including identical protein binding activity; protein-folding chaperone binding activity; and translation elongation factor activity. Involved in maintenance of translational fidelity; positive regulation of translational elongation; and translational elongation. Is active in cytosol. Used to study spinocerebellar ataxia 26. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glaucoma; spinocerebellar ataxia 26; and stomach cancer. Orthologous to human EEF2 (eukaryotic translation elongation factor 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852003.name: RPT3
852003.description: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT3
852003.otherdesignations: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT3
852003.nomenclaturename: proteasome regulatory particle base subunit RPT3
852003.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of RNA polymerase II transcription preinitiation complex assembly; proteasome regulatory particle assembly; and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Part of proteasome regulatory particle, base subcomplex. Used to study hereditary spastic paraplegia. Orthologous to human PSMC4 (proteasome 26S subunit, ATPase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852004.name: SXM1
852004.summary: Enables nuclear import signal receptor activity. Involved in mRNA export from nucleus and protein import into nucleus. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human IPO7 (importin 7) and IPO8 (importin 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852008.name: HPT1
852008.summary: Enables hypoxanthine phosphoribosyltransferase activity. Involved in GMP salvage and IMP salvage. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852009.name: URH1
852009.description: trifunctional uridine nucleosidase/nicotinamide riboside hydrolase/nicotinic acid riboside hydrolase
852009.otherdesignations: trifunctional uridine nucleosidase/nicotinamide riboside hydrolase/nicotinic acid riboside hydrolase
852009.nomenclaturename: trifunctional uridine nucleosidase/nicotinamide riboside hydrolase/nicotinic acid riboside hydrolase
852009.summary: Enables nicotinamide riboside hydrolase activity; nicotinic acid riboside hydrolase activity; and uridine nucleosidase activity. Involved in nucleobase-containing small molecule metabolic process and pyrimidine-containing compound salvage. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852018.name: SIZ1
852018.summary: Enables SUMO transferase activity and double-stranded DNA binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA double-strand break attachment to nuclear envelope; negative regulation of protein ubiquitination; and protein sumoylation. Located in chromatin and septin ring. Orthologous to several human genes including PIAS2 (protein inhibitor of activated STAT 2); PIAS3 (protein inhibitor of activated STAT 3); and PIAS4 (protein inhibitor of activated STAT 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852026.name: RPL12B
852026.summary: Predicted to enable large ribosomal subunit rRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in ribosomal large subunit assembly. Acts upstream of or within ribophagy. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in systemic lupus erythematosus. Orthologous to human RPL12 (ribosomal protein L12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852032.name: SIP1
852032.summary: Enables enzyme-substrate adaptor activity. Contributes to AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Involved in regulation of protein-containing complex assembly and signal transduction. Located in cytosol; fungal-type vacuole; and vacuolar membrane. Part of nucleotide-activated protein kinase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852034.name: DYN2
852034.summary: Contributes to plus-end-directed microtubule motor activity. Involved in establishment of mitotic spindle localization; nuclear migration along microtubule; and nuclear pore complex assembly. Located in cytoplasmic microtubule. Part of cytoplasmic dynein complex and peroxisomal importomer complex. Orthologous to human DYNLL1 (dynein light chain LC8-type 1) and DYNLL2 (dynein light chain LC8-type 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852035.name: SNX41
852035.summary: Enables phosphatidylinositol binding activity and phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Involved in intracellular protein transport; macroautophagy; and retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi. Located in cytoplasmic side of endosome membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852042.name: NPL3
852042.summary: Enables several functions, including RNA binding activity; double-stranded telomeric DNA binding activity; and eukaryotic initiation factor 4G binding activity. Involved in autophagosome-lysosome fusion; gene expression; and regulation of gene expression. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in neurodevelopmental disorder with dysmorphic facies and behavioral abnormalities; proliferative diabetic retinopathy; and spermatogenic failure 3. Orthologous to several human genes including SRSF1 (serine and arginine rich splicing factor 1); SRSF4 (serine and arginine rich splicing factor 4); and SRSF5 (serine and arginine rich splicing factor 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852050.name: DOT1
852050.summary: Enables histone H3K79 methyltransferase activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA metabolic process; chromatin remodeling; and negative regulation of cell cycle phase transition. Located in nucleus. Used to study leukemia. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Nil-Deshwar neurodevelopmental syndrome and acute biphenotypic leukemia. Orthologous to human DOT1L (DOT1 like histone lysine methyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852059.name: ADA2
852059.summary: Enables chromatin binding activity; phosphatidylserine binding activity; and transcription coactivator activity. Involved in heterochromatin formation; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II; and replication-born double-strand break repair via sister chromatid exchange. Part of ADA complex; SAGA complex; and SLIK (SAGA-like) complex. Orthologous to several human genes including TADA2A (transcriptional adaptor 2A). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852061.name: RPS18A
852061.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in endonucleolytic cleavage in ITS1 to separate SSU-rRNA from 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA) and ribosomal subunit export from nucleus. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human RPS18 (ribosomal protein S18). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852068.name: TOM1
852068.summary: Enables ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. Involved in several processes, including endonucleolytic cleavage of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA); protein ubiquitination; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in nucleolus. Used to study non-syndromic X-linked intellectual disability 50. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in syndromic X-linked intellectual disability Turner type. Orthologous to human HUWE1 (HECT, UBA and WWE domain containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852070.name: PFA5
852070.summary: Enables palmitoyltransferase activity. Involved in protein palmitoylation. Located in plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852077.name: PKH3
852077.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in cell integrity MAPK cascade. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852088.name: SNF1
852088.description: AMP-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase catalytic subunit SNF1
852088.otheraliases: YDR477W, CAT1, CCR1, GLC2, HAF3, PAS14
852088.otherdesignations: AMP-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase catalytic subunit SNF1
852088.nomenclaturename: AMP-activated serine/threonine-protein kinase catalytic subunit SNF1
852088.summary: Enables several functions, including AMP-activated protein kinase activity; guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity; and identical protein binding activity. Involved in several processes, including invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; regulation of carbohydrate biosynthetic process; and regulation of filamentous growth of a population of unicellular organisms. Located in cellular bud neck septin ring; nuclear envelope lumen; and vacuolar membrane. Part of nucleotide-activated protein kinase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Huntington's disease; breast cancer; colon cancer; and type 2 diabetes mellitus. Orthologous to human PRKAA1 (protein kinase AMP-activated catalytic subunit alpha 1) and PRKAA2 (protein kinase AMP-activated catalytic subunit alpha 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852101.name: PKH1
852101.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including cell integrity MAPK cascade; late endosome to vacuole transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway; and positive regulation of cytoplasmic mRNA processing body assembly. Located in cell cortex and cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in prostate cancer. Orthologous to human PDPK1 (3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase 1) and PDPK2P (3-phosphoinositide dependent protein kinase 2, pseudogene). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852111.name: RPL37B
852111.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in cleavage in ITS2 between 5.8S rRNA and LSU-rRNA of tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit and preribosome, large subunit precursor. Orthologous to human RPL37 (ribosomal protein L37). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852119.name: GIN4
852119.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including budding cell bud growth; mitotic morphogenesis checkpoint signaling; and septin ring assembly. Located in cellular bud neck. Is active in cellular bud neck septin ring. Orthologous to human BRSK1 (BR serine/threonine kinase 1) and BRSK2 (BR serine/threonine kinase 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852125.name: EMI1
852125.summary: Involved in mitochondrion organization. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852130.name: EUG1
852130.summary: Enables protein disulfide isomerase activity; protein-disulfide reductase (glutathione) activity; and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in protein folding. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Cole-Carpenter syndrome and autoimmune hepatitis. Orthologous to several human genes including PDIA3 (protein disulfide isomerase family A member 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852135.name: SPS1
852135.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including ascospore wall assembly; meiotic spindle disassembly; and negative regulation of protein localization to nucleolus. Located in cytoplasm; nucleus; and prospore membrane. Used to study nervous system disease. Orthologous to human STK26 (serine/threonine kinase 26). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852142.name: QCR7
852142.summary: Contributes to quinol-cytochrome-c reductase activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c and mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III assembly. Located in matrix side of mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in inherited metabolic disorder and mitochondrial complex III deficiency nuclear type 3. Orthologous to human UQCRB (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase binding protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852168.name: SRO77
852168.summary: Predicted to enable GTPase activator activity and myosin II binding activity. Involved in Golgi to plasma membrane transport and exocytosis. Located in plasma membrane. Orthologous to several human genes including LLGL1 (LLGL scribble cell polarity complex component 1); LLGL2 (LLGL scribble cell polarity complex component 2); and STXBP5L (syntaxin binding protein 5L). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852171.name: RTG3
852171.summary: Enables DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II-specific DNA-binding transcription factor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to oleic acid; mitochondria-nucleus signaling pathway; and peroxisome fission. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Tietz syndrome; Tietze's syndrome; Waardenburg syndrome; Waardenburg syndrome type 2A; and familial melanoma. Orthologous to human MITF (melanocyte inducing transcription factor). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852177.name: ATP1
852177.summary: Contributes to ATP hydrolysis activity and proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane and mitochondrial nucleoid. Part of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 22; mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 4A; and mitochondrial complex V (ATP synthase) deficiency nuclear type 4B. Orthologous to human ATP5F1A (ATP synthase F1 subunit alpha). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852191.name: RPL23A
852191.summary: Predicted to enable large ribosomal subunit rRNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL23 (ribosomal protein L23). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852196.name: ALG3
852196.summary: Enables dol-P-Man:Man(5)GlcNAc(2)-PP-Dol alpha-1,3-mannosyltransferase activity. Involved in dolichol-linked oligosaccharide biosynthetic process. Located in endoplasmic reticulum. Used to study congenital disorder of glycosylation and congenital disorder of glycosylation Id. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital disorder of glycosylation Id. Orthologous to human ALG3 (ALG3 alpha-1,3- mannosyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852198.name: PET112
852198.summary: Enables glutaminyl-tRNA synthase (glutamine-hydrolyzing) activity. Involved in glutaminyl-tRNAGln biosynthesis via transamidation and mitochondrial translation. Located in mitochondrion. Part of glutamyl-tRNA(Gln) amidotransferase complex. Used to study cardiomyopathy. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 41. Orthologous to human GATB (glutamyl-tRNA amidotransferase subunit B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852199.name: NUP170
852199.summary: Enables promoter-specific chromatin binding activity. A structural constituent of nuclear pore. Involved in several processes, including nuclear pore complex assembly; protein localization to nuclear inner membrane; and telomere tethering at nuclear periphery. Part of nuclear pore inner ring. Is active in chromosome, subtelomeric region. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in familial atrial fibrillation. Orthologous to human NUP155 (nucleoporin 155). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852200.name: ATG8
852200.summary: Enables phosphatidylethanolamine binding activity and protein tag activity. Involved in several processes, including lipid droplet formation; macroautophagy; and protein targeting to vacuole. Located in several cellular components, including phagophore assembly site; vacuole; and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Is active in lipid droplet. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in glioblastoma. Orthologous to several human genes including GABARAPL1 (GABA type A receptor associated protein like 1) and GABARAPL3 (GABA type A receptor associated protein like 3 (pseudogene)). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852203.name: SSA3
852203.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane, translocation; protein folding; and protein quality control for misfolded or incompletely synthesized proteins. Located in cytosol. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including artery disease (multiple); autoimmune disease of musculoskeletal system (multiple); lung disease (multiple); neurodegenerative disease (multiple); and schizophrenia (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including HSPA1L (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 1 like); HSPA1A (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 1A); and HSPA1B (heat shock protein family A (Hsp70) member 1B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852215.name: PRX1
852215.summary: Enables thioredoxin peroxidase activity. Involved in cell redox homeostasis. Located in mitochondrion. Orthologous to human PRDX6 (peroxiredoxin 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852228.name: SAS3
852228.summary: Enables histone acetyltransferase activity. Involved in silent mating-type cassette heterochromatin formation and subtelomeric heterochromatin formation. Part of NuA3a histone acetyltransferase complex and NuA3b histone acetyltransferase complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Ohdo syndrome, SBBYS variant; bipolar disorder; breast cancer; and leiomyoma. Orthologous to human KAT6B (lysine acetyltransferase 6B) and KAT7 (lysine acetyltransferase 7). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852231.name: MOH1
852231.summary: Predicted to enable zinc ion binding activity. Predicted to be part of ubiquitin ligase complex. Orthologous to several human genes including YPEL1 (yippee like 1); YPEL2 (yippee like 2); and YPEL3 (yippee like 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852235.name: COR1
852235.summary: Contributes to quinol-cytochrome-c reductase activity. Involved in mitochondrial electron transport, ubiquinol to cytochrome c. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of respiratory chain complex III. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Alzheimer's disease. Orthologous to human UQCRC1 (ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase core protein 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852250.name: PET9
852250.summary: Enables ATP:ADP antiporter activity and cardiolipin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular respiration; heme transport; and purine ribonucleotide transport. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Used to study hypertrophic cardiomyopathy; lactic acidosis; mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome (multiple); and myopathy (multiple). Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in intrinsic cardiomyopathy (multiple); mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome (multiple); and mitochondrial myopathy (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including SLC25A4 (solute carrier family 25 member 4); SLC25A5 (solute carrier family 25 member 5); and SLC25A6 (solute carrier family 25 member 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852254.name: RPL19B
852254.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL19 (ribosomal protein L19). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852259.name: PIM1
852259.summary: Enables ATP-dependent peptidase activity. Involved in chaperone-mediated protein complex assembly; mitochondrial protein quality control; and regulation of mitochondrial DNA metabolic process. Located in mitochondrial matrix. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in CODAS syndrome. Orthologous to human LONP1 (lon peptidase 1, mitochondrial). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852260.name: HAP3
852260.summary: Contributes to DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of cellular respiration. Part of CCAAT-binding activity factor complex. Orthologous to human NFYB (nuclear transcription factor Y subunit beta). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852266.name: ACH1
852266.summary: Enables acetate CoA-transferase activity and acetyl-CoA hydrolase activity. Involved in acetate metabolic process. Located in cytosol and mitochondrion. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852270.name: FMT1
852270.summary: Enables methionyl-tRNA formyltransferase activity. Involved in conversion of methionyl-tRNA to N-formyl-methionyl-tRNA. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 15 and nuclear type mitochondrial complex I deficiency 27. Orthologous to human MTFMT (mitochondrial methionyl-tRNA formyltransferase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852275.name: HIR1
852275.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity and transcription corepressor activity. Contributes to DNA binding activity and nucleosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription; nucleosome assembly; and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II. Located in chromosome, centromeric region. Part of HIR complex. Orthologous to human HIRA (histone cell cycle regulator). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852276.name: SLA1
852276.summary: Enables several functions, including cargo adaptor activity; identical protein binding activity; and ubiquitin binding activity. Involved in several processes, including actin cortical patch assembly; cell wall organization; and negative regulation of Arp2/3 complex-mediated actin nucleation. Located in actin cortical patch and nucleus. Part of SLAC complex and actin cytoskeleton-regulatory complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852288.name: COQ1
852288.summary: Enables heptaprenyl diphosphate synthase activity. Involved in ubiquinone biosynthetic process. Is extrinsic component of mitochondrial inner membrane. Is active in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 2. Orthologous to human PDSS1 (decaprenyl diphosphate synthase subunit 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852303.name: MNN2
852303.summary: Enables alpha-1,2-mannosyltransferase activity. Involved in glycoprotein biosynthetic process. Located in Golgi apparatus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852314.name: ETR1
852314.summary: Enables enoyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] reductase (NADPH) activity. Involved in aerobic respiration and fatty acid biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrion. Used to study Leber hereditary optic neuropathy with demyelinating disease of CNS. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in childhood-onset dystonia with optic atrophy and basal ganglia abnormalities and optic atrophy. Orthologous to human MECR (mitochondrial trans-2-enoyl-CoA reductase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852319.name: RPL4A
852319.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL4 (ribosomal protein L4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852322.name: HMT1
852322.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity; protein-arginine omega-N asymmetric methyltransferase activity; and protein-arginine omega-N monomethyltransferase activity. Involved in folic acid biosynthetic process; mRNA export from nucleus; and regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Located in nucleus. Orthologous to human PRMT1 (protein arginine methyltransferase 1) and PRMT8 (protein arginine methyltransferase 8). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852323.name: PDX3
852323.summary: Enables FMN binding activity and pyridoxamine phosphate oxidase activity. Predicted to be involved in pyridoxal 5'-phosphate biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate oxidase deficiency. Orthologous to human PNPO (pyridoxamine 5'-phosphate oxidase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852324.name: CSG2
852324.summary: Enables enzyme regulator activity and intracellularly gated calcium channel activity. Involved in endoplasmic reticulum calcium ion homeostasis; glycolipid metabolic process; and release of sequestered calcium ion into cytosol by endoplasmic reticulum. Located in Golgi apparatus. Is active in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Used to study Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852327.name: ATP3
852327.summary: Contributes to proton-transporting ATP synthase activity, rotational mechanism and proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. Part of proton-transporting ATP synthase complex. Orthologous to human ATP5F1C (ATP synthase F1 subunit gamma). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852329.name: FAT1
852329.summary: Enables long-chain fatty acid transmembrane transporter activity and very long-chain fatty acid-CoA ligase activity. Involved in long-chain fatty acid import into cell; protein quality control for misfolded or incompletely synthesized proteins; and very long-chain fatty acid metabolic process. Located in several cellular components, including cytoplasmic side of plasma membrane; lipid droplet; and peroxisome. Orthologous to several human genes including SLC27A1 (solute carrier family 27 member 1); SLC27A2 (solute carrier family 27 member 2); and SLC27A3 (solute carrier family 27 member 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852330.name: CST26
852330.summary: Enables acyltransferase activity. Involved in phosphatidylinositol acyl-chain remodeling. Located in lipid droplet. Orthologous to several human genes including AGPAT3 (1-acylglycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase 3) and AGPAT4 (1-acylglycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852332.name: TCM62
852332.summary: Predicted to enable protein-folding chaperone binding activity and unfolded protein binding activity. Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex II assembly. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852335.name: ZTA1
852335.summary: Enables 2-alkenal reductase [NAD(P)H] activity; mRNA 3'-UTR AU-rich region binding activity; and quinone reductase (NADPH) activity. Involved in cellular response to oxidative stress. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Orthologous to human CRYZ (crystallin zeta) and TP53I3 (tumor protein p53 inducible protein 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852346.name: MRX18
852346.summary: Predicted to enable glucan endo-1,6-beta-glucosidase activity and glucan exo-1,3-beta-glucosidase activity. Predicted to be involved in glucan catabolic process. Located in mitochondrial intermembrane space. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852348.name: MUM2
852348.summary: Involved in negative regulation of pseudohyphal growth and premeiotic DNA replication. Located in cytoplasm and nucleolus. Part of RNA N6-methyladenosine methyltransferase complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852349.name: UBP14
852349.summary: Enables cysteine-type deubiquitinase activity. Involved in negative regulation of gluconeogenesis and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Predicted to be located in cytoplasm. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Orthologous to human USP13 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 13) and USP5 (ubiquitin specific peptidase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852351.name: AKL1
852351.summary: Enables protein serine/threonine kinase activity. Involved in negative regulation of clathrin-dependent endocytosis. Located in several cellular components, including cell periphery; cellular bud neck; and prospore membrane. Orthologous to human BMP2K (BMP2 inducible kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852360.name: BAP2
852360.summary: Enables L-phenylalanine transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in L-leucine import across plasma membrane. Located in plasma membrane. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in retinitis pigmentosa 68. Orthologous to human SLC7A14 (solute carrier family 7 member 14) and SLC7A4 (solute carrier family 7 member 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852370.name: ECM33
852370.summary: Involved in fungal-type cell wall organization. Located in fungal-type cell wall and plasma membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852378.name: MIS1
852378.description: trifunctional formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase/methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase/methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase MIS1
852378.otherdesignations: trifunctional formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase/methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase/methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase MIS1
852378.nomenclaturename: trifunctional formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase/methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase/methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase MIS1
852378.summary: Enables formate-tetrahydrofolate ligase activity; methenyltetrahydrofolate cyclohydrolase activity; and methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity. Involved in folic acid biosynthetic process. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including Down syndrome; abdominal aortic aneurysm; cleft lip; developmental cardiac valvular defect; and neural tube defect (multiple). Orthologous to human MTHFD1L (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase (NADP+ dependent) 1 like) and MTHFD1 (methylenetetrahydrofolate dehydrogenase, cyclohydrolase and formyltetrahydrofolate synthetase 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852379.name: RPL19A
852379.summary: Predicted to enable RNA binding activity. Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Orthologous to human RPL19 (ribosomal protein L19). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852380.name: AAC3
852380.summary: Enables identical protein binding activity. Involved in anaerobic respiration and heme transport. Located in mitochondrion. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in intrinsic cardiomyopathy (multiple); mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome (multiple); and mitochondrial myopathy (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including SLC25A4 (solute carrier family 25 member 4); SLC25A5 (solute carrier family 25 member 5); and SLC25A6 (solute carrier family 25 member 6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852392.name: RXT2
852392.summary: Contributes to histone deacetylase activity. Involved in several processes, including invasive growth in response to glucose limitation; negative regulation of heterochromatin formation; and positive regulation of invasive growth in response to glucose limitation. Located in cytosol and nucleus. Part of Rpd3L complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852399.name: SIF2
852399.summary: Predicted to enable transcription corepressor activity. Involved in negative regulation of meiotic nuclear division; positive regulation of stress-activated MAPK cascade; and regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Located in nucleus. Part of Set3 complex. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Pierpont syndrome; Y-linked deafness 2; autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 41; and congenital nongoitrous hypothyroidism 8. Orthologous to several human genes including TBL1XR1 (TBL1X/Y related 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852417.name: CBP6
852417.summary: Enables ribosome binding activity. Involved in mitochondrial respiratory chain complex III assembly; positive regulation of mitochondrial translation; and protein stabilization. Located in mitochondrial ribosome. Part of Cbp3p-Cbp6 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852424.name: VMA2
852424.description: H(+)-transporting V1 sector ATPase subunit B
852424.otherdesignations: H(+)-transporting V1 sector ATPase subunit B
852424.nomenclaturename: H(+)-transporting V1 sector ATPase subunit B
852424.summary: Enables proton-transporting ATPase activity, rotational mechanism. Involved in several processes, including intracellular monoatomic cation homeostasis; pexophagy; and proteasome storage granule assembly. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane; membrane raft; and vacuole-mitochondrion membrane contact site. Part of vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase, V1 domain. Used to study follicular lymphoma and renal tubular acidosis. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant congenital deafness with onychodystrophy and renal tubular acidosis. Orthologous to several human genes including ATP6V1B1 (ATPase H+ transporting V1 subunit B1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852425.name: ATG14
852425.summary: Involved in cellular response to potassium ion starvation; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and macroautophagy. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane; phagophore assembly site; and vacuole-isolation membrane contact site. Part of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase complex, class III, type I. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852433.name: MEC1
852433.summary: Enables protein kinase activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA metabolic process; positive regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication; and regulation of termination of RNA polymerase II transcription. Located in nucleus. Is active in replication fork. Used to study several diseases, including Seckel syndrome; ataxia telangiectasia; colon cancer; endometrial cancer; and non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Seckel syndrome 1; adenoid cystic carcinoma; colon cancer; lung cancer; and pancreatic cancer. Orthologous to human ATR (ATR checkpoint kinase). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852444.name: RTC2
852444.summary: Enables L-histidine transmembrane transporter activity. Involved in L-histidine transmembrane import into vacuole and basic amino acid transmembrane export from vacuole. Located in fungal-type vacuole membrane. Orthologous to human SLC66A1 (solute carrier family 66 member 1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852455.name: AMN1
852455.summary: Enables small GTPase binding activity. Involved in several processes, including SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process; negative regulation of mitotic cell cycle phase transition; and negative regulation of septum digestion after cytokinesis. Located in cellular bud; cytoplasm; and nucleus. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852469.name: SEC66
852469.summary: Contributes to transmembrane protein transporter activity. Involved in filamentous growth and post-translational protein targeting to membrane, translocation. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Part of Sec62/Sec63 complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852471.name: UMP1
852471.summary: Involved in DNA damage response; proteasome assembly; and ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Located in cytoplasm and nucleus. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in proteosome-associated autoinflammatory syndrome 2. Orthologous to human POMP (proteasome maturation protein). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852472.name: SWD3
852472.summary: Contributes to histone H3K4 methyltransferase activity. Involved in regulation of meiotic DNA double-strand break formation; subtelomeric heterochromatin formation; and telomere maintenance. Part of Set1C/COMPASS complex. Orthologous to human WDR5 (WD repeat domain 5) and WDR5B (WD repeat domain 5B). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852479.name: RPS6B
852479.summary: A structural constituent of ribosome. Involved in maturation of SSU-rRNA from tricistronic rRNA transcript (SSU-rRNA, 5.8S rRNA, LSU-rRNA). Located in cytoplasm. Part of cytosolic small ribosomal subunit and small-subunit processome. Orthologous to human RPS6 (ribosomal protein S6). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852481.name: YPC1
852481.summary: Enables N-acylsphingosine amidohydrolase activity and sphingosine N-acyltransferase activity. Involved in ceramide biosynthetic process and ceramide catabolic process. Located in cortical endoplasmic reticulum. Used to study leukodystrophy. Orthologous to human ACER3 (alkaline ceramidase 3). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852483.name: MBA1
852483.summary: Enables mitochondrial ribosome binding activity. Involved in positive regulation of mitochondrial translation and protein insertion into mitochondrial inner membrane from matrix. Located in mitochondrial inner membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852484.name: PCH2
852484.summary: Enables ATP hydrolysis activity. Involved in meiotic DNA double-strand break formation; meiotic recombination checkpoint signaling; and reciprocal meiotic recombination. Located in nucleolus. Used to study infertility. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 3. Orthologous to human TRIP13 (thyroid hormone receptor interactor 13). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852489.name: RPL21A
852489.summary: Predicted to be a structural constituent of ribosome. Predicted to be involved in cytoplasmic translation. Part of cytosolic large ribosomal subunit. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in hypotrichosis 12. Orthologous to human RPL21 (ribosomal protein L21). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852499.name: BEM1
852499.summary: Enables molecular adaptor activity and phosphatidylinositol-3-phosphate binding activity. Involved in cell morphogenesis involved in conjugation with cellular fusion; maintenance of protein location; and positive regulation of vacuole fusion, non-autophagic. Located in several cellular components, including cellular bud neck; cellular bud tip; and incipient cellular bud site. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in Frank-Ter Haar syndrome; autosomal recessive chronic granulomatous disease 3; and rheumatoid arthritis. Orthologous to several human genes including SH3PXD2B (SH3 and PX domains 2B); NCF4 (neutrophil cytosolic factor 4); and SORBS2 (sorbin and SH3 domain containing 2). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852500.name: DER1
852500.summary: Enables misfolded protein binding activity. Involved in misfolded protein transport; protein quality control for misfolded or incompletely synthesized proteins; and retrograde protein transport, ER to cytosol. Located in endoplasmic reticulum membrane. Part of Hrd1p ubiquitin ligase ERAD-L complex. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852518.name: ATG12
852518.summary: Enables enzyme activator activity and protein tag activity. Contributes to Atg8-family ligase activity. Involved in autophagy of mitochondrion; cytoplasm to vacuole targeting by the Cvt pathway; and macroautophagy. Located in cytosol. Part of Atg12-Atg5-Atg16 complex. Orthologous to human ATG12 (autophagy related 12). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852532.name: SWC5
852532.summary: Involved in chromatin remodeling. Located in chromatin; cytosol; and nucleus. Part of Swr1 complex. Orthologous to human CFDP1 (chromatin remodeling protein CFDP1). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]

852540.name: AAG1
852540.summary: Enables mRNA binding activity. Involved in aerobic respiration. Located in P-body and mitochondrial membrane. [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852546.name: GPX2
852546.summary: Enables glutathione peroxidase activity and phospholipid-hydroperoxide glutathione peroxidase activity. Involved in cellular response to oxidative stress. Located in cytoplasm. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in colorectal adenocarcinoma; colorectal cancer; and spondylometaphyseal dysplasia Sedaghatian type. Orthologous to human GPX4 (glutathione peroxidase 4). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jul 2025]

852547.name: ISW1
852547.summary: Enables mRNA 3'-UTR binding activity; nucleosome array spacer activity; and sequence-specific double-stranded DNA binding activity. Contributes to ATP hydrolysis activity; DNA binding activity; and nucleosome binding activity. Involved in several processes, including DNA-templated transcription; negative regulation of IRE1-mediated unfolded protein response; and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II. Located in nucleolar chromatin. Part of Isw1a complex and Isw1b complex. Is active in nucleus. Orthologous to human SMARCA1 (SNF2 related chromatin remodeling ATPase 1) and SMARCA5 (SNF2 related chromatin remodeling ATPase 5). [provided by Alliance of Genome Resources, Jun 2026]
